stories.headline: Several dead and seriously injured in head-on motorway collision in Ireland

opening: A number of people have died and others have been seriously injured in a crash involving a car driving in the wrong direction on a highway in Ireland, Irish police said.

Commissioner Justin Kelly described the head-on collision between two cars on the M9 as “horrific” and warned that “in some cases” cars are being driven on the wrong side of highways for social media likes.
body: Police said they are investigating the circumstances of the crash at junction 3 at about 3am on Sunday.
